INDEPENDENT · UNOFFICIAL FIELD GUIDE

Aimed Shot Marksmanship Hunter build

Last updated: November 14, 2026

Field guide

What is Azeroth Survivors?How to playBuildsTier listDownload & fixesSafety checkTalent treeLuck

Psychedelic’s Marksman setup uses Aimed Shot as the main investment for Heroic Naxxramas and a 40-minute Endless attempt. The full tree uses 7 Beast Mastery, 32 Marksmanship and 12 Survival.

Build the gear set before testing Heroic

The author suggests collecting four pieces while progressing through Normal toward the Temple of Ahn’Qiraj, then completing eight-piece Cryptstalker in Naxxramas. Record the pieces you own before judging the build. Band of Accuria and Master Dragonslayer’s Ring are the primary offensive rings in the shared setup.

Keep the draft centered on Aimed Shot

The planner lists Auto Shot, Aimed Shot, Hunter’s Mark, Multi-Shot, Concussive Shot and Frost Trap. Its loadout marks Auto Shot, Multi-Shot and Concussive Shot for banishment. The author gives Aimed Shot most upgrades and keeps room for a strong Frost Trap card when pack control matters.

Adjust jewelry to the reason you lost

If Heroic survival is the limit, the author lists Star of Mystaria as a defensive option. Try that change before changing the talent tree. If damage is the limit, compare runs with the same necklace and Aimed Shot upgrades so the gear change is easier to evaluate.
